description: This file defines the ILocalDataStore interface within the Orleans.Storage namespace, specifying methods for data storage operations such as reading, writing, deleting, and clearing data rows.

classes.name: ILocalDataStore
classes.description: Interface defining methods for local data storage operations in Orleans.

methods.name: Etag
methods.description: Read-only property that gets the ETag identifier.

methods.name: WriteRow
methods.description: Writes a row of data identified by keys and returns an ETag string.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a single data row based on provided keys.

methods.name: ReadMultiRow
methods.description: Reads multiple data rows based on the provided list of keys.

methods.name: DeleteRow
methods.description: Deletes a data row specified by keys and ETag; returns success status.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears all data from the store.
